pageTitle: Nico's Weg – A1 | Learn German | DW
pageText:
Nico's Weg is a free German course from Deutsche Welle, told as a video story. The A1 course follows Nico, who arrives in Germany and has to manage everyday situations: introducing himself, asking for directions, shopping, ordering in a cafe. Each episode is two to four minutes and is followed by exercises on the vocabulary and structures it used. Subtitles can be switched on in German or English, and every episode has a transcript. The course covers the A1 curriculum in around 60 hours and is followed by A2 and B1 courses in the same format.
